command: set -u; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; whoami; date -u -Iseconds; echo '===REPOS==='; for d in "$HOME/frankenstein-2.0" "$HOME/self-integration" "$HOME/frankenstein-repo" "$HOME/clay-global-research-entity" "$HOME/.claude/star"; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then echo "--- $d"; if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then git -C "$d" status --short --branch 2>/dev/null | head -40; printf 'HEAD '; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; printf 'BRANCH '; git -C "$d" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true; printf 'REMOTE_MAIN '; git -C "$d" rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || true; else echo NO_GIT; fi; fi; done; echo '===PROCESSES==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,pcpu,pmem,etime,comm,args --sort=-pcpu | grep -Ei 'frank|clay|grid10|cortex|avatar|gespraech|retina|entityos|hcu|jspace' | grep -v grep | head -80 || true; echo '===SYSTEM_SERVICES==='; systemctl --no-pager --plain --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'frank|clay|grid|cortex|avatar|gespraech|retina|entityos' | head -80 || true; echo '===USER_SERVICES==='; systemctl --user --no-pager --plain --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'frank|clay|grid|cortex|avatar|gespraech|retina|entityos' | head -80 || true; echo '===TIMERS==='; systemctl --no-pager --plain list-timers --all 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'frank|clay|grid|cortex|avatar|retina|entityos' | head -80 || true; systemctl --user --no-pager --plain list-timers --all 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'frank|clay|grid|cortex|avatar|retina|entityos' | head -80 || true; echo '===DONE==='
